AK_EXUSIAI_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_AMMO.title: Ammo
AK_EXUSIAI_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_AMMO.descr: When you play an Attack, each hit spends [blue]1[/blue] Ammo and gains extra damage based on your Ammo when the Attack is played ([blue]+1[/blue] per [blue]5[/blue] Ammo, at least [blue]+2[/blue]). Maximum [blue]30[/blue] Ammo; reaching the maximum enters [gold]Overload[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_MYSTERY_RELIC.title: Mystery Relic
AK_EXUSIAI_MYSTERY_RELIC.description: A relic determined by the run seed. It is revealed the first time you play [gold]Free Delivery[/gold].
AK_EXUSIAI_FIREPOWER_GENERIC.description: Firepower causes Ammo to deal additional damage.
When a [gold]Transit[/gold] relic under [gold]Delivery[/gold] gains [gold]Transit[/gold], reduce its [gold]Delivery[/gold] instead.
